blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward模型从短视频窗口准确估计了相机运动和3D几何. 然而,计算和内存成本阻止了对包含千帧的序列的直接推论. 因此,长片必须作为重叠块处理。 该处进行独立的当地重建,坐标框架不一致,共用相机的估计数重复。 要实现全球一致性,就必须宣传来自相邻重叠的制约因素,并在整个序列中进行遥远的重新审视。 这一要求自然激发了图的优化。 然而,图级的选择会产生权衡. 春克级图能高效地解决尺度漂移并关闭大环. 然而,它们的刚性转变无法纠正内部错误或相互冲突的帧预测. 反之,帧级优化则可以提供局部灵活性,但在全球范围扩展则计算成本昂贵,可以打破度量衡. HiP3R用一个等级姿势图来解决这种权衡. HiP3R首先优化了坚固的块级$\mathrm{Sim}(3)$的图表,以建立全局布局和尺度. 然后它会固定这种布局,并估计每个帧一个共享的$\mathrm{SE}(3)$的相机,将重叠的窗口预测变成一个单一的轨迹. 跨越多个基准的实验证明了HiP3R在改进相机轨迹和3D重建方面的有效性. 我们的方法既适用于块式后端,也适用于流式后端,没有额外的训练或微调. 编码见https://kakkkka.github.io/HiP3R。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recovering globally consistent 3D geometry and camera trajectories from video is fundamental to computer vision.
This capability supports autonomous navigation, robotic mapping, and spatial artificial intelligence.
Recent 3D foundation models ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) have significantly advanced visual geometry.
By jointly predicting camera poses and dense pointmaps in a single forward pass, they bypass classical handcrafted matching.
These models achieve high accuracy on short video clips without per-scene calibration or optimization.
However, the quadratic complexity of visual attention limits them to short temporal windows.
Directly scaling transformers to extended multi-kilometer sequences remains too expensive.
blocks.zh:
从视频中恢复全球一致的三维几何和相机轨迹对计算机视觉至关重要。
这种能力支持自主导航,机器人绘图,以及空间人工智能.
近期的3D基础模型(Wang et al.,2024;Wang et al.,2025a;Wang et al.,2026b)具有显著的视觉几何先进性.
通过联合预测相机姿势和单向前传的密集点图,它们绕过古典手工匹配.
这些模型在短视频短片片段上实现了高精度,没有进行人均场景校准或优化.
然而,视觉注意力的四面体复杂性限制了它们短时间窗口.
将变压器直接缩放到延伸的多公里序列仍然过于昂贵.

blocks.en:
To process long videos, modern systems adopt a divide-and-conquer strategy ( Deng et al., 2025 ) .
Long sequences are divided into overlapping video chunks, which are processed independently and stitched together.
While chunking bounds GPU memory, sequential alignment introduces severe computational and numerical bottlenecks.
Dense overlapping points share high spatial redundancy, making all-pixel alignment computationally expensive.
Furthermore, pairwise alignment errors compound along the sequential chain, causing severe scale and orientation drift.
Loop closures are essential to eliminate cumulative drift and enforce global topological consistency.
However, when the chains are not yet aligned, applying multiple long-range loop constraints at once can make the non-convex optimization unstable. The solver may diverge or converge to poor local minima.
blocks.zh:
为了处理长视频,现代系统采取了分化和征服战略(Deng等人,2025年)。
长序分为重叠的视频块,它们独立处理,并缝合.
在对GPU内存进行块化时,顺序对齐引入了严重的计算和数值瓶颈.
Dense重叠点共享高度空间冗余,使得全像素对齐计算成本昂贵.
此外,双向对齐误差沿着顺序链复合,造成严重尺度和方向漂移。
环闭对消除累积漂移现象和加强全球地形一致性至关重要。
然而,当链条尚未对齐时,一次应用多个长程圈限制可以使非锥体优化不稳定. 解决者可能与贫穷的本地迷你体发生分歧或趋同。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overlapping predictions recover local geometry in inconsistent frames. Coarse layout optimization corrects global placement and scale, but keeps each chunk’s internal cameras. Shared-camera trajectory refinement estimates one trajectory from predictions and within-chunk motion.
blocks.zh: 图 1:重叠预测在不一致的帧中恢复局部几何. 粗糙的布局优化纠正了全球布局和尺度,但保留每个块的内部摄像头. 共享摄像头轨迹的完善从预测和圆内运动中估计出一个轨迹。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 1 , even after global chunk placement is resolved, a conflict remains at the frame level.
Existing alignment methods ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) optimize similarity transformations per chunk.
However, a single similarity transform preserves internal camera configurations up to scale.
Consequently, it cannot resolve cross-window camera-pose inconsistency.
Overlapping chunks produce multiple, conflicting pose estimates of the same frame under differing visual contexts.
A chunk is an inference unit, whereas the true trajectory contains only one camera pose per frame.
Arbitrarily selecting one prediction discards multi-view evidence and causes velocity jumps across chunk boundaries.
Conversely, full bundle adjustment is too expensive, while relative motion alone drifts from the recovered global layout.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,即使在全球块布置问题得到解决后,冲突仍保持在框架一级。
现有对齐方法(邓等人,2025年;张等人,2026年b;Xiong等人,2026年) 优化每个块的相似性变换.
然而,一个单一的相似性变换可以保存高达规模的内部相机配置.
因此,它不能解决跨窗口相机的不一致问题。
重叠块在不同的视觉背景下产生对同一框架的多重、相互冲突的估计。
一个块是一个推断单元,而真实的轨迹只包含每个帧一个相机姿势.
任意选择一种预测会丢弃多视图证据,导致速度跨越块边界跳跃。
反之,完全捆绑的调整过于昂贵,而仅相对运动就偏离了恢复的全球布局。

blocks.en:
To overcome these challenges, we introduce HiP3R , a Hierarchical Pose-graph optimization method for long-horizon 3D Reconstruction. HiP3R decomposes reconstruction into coarse chunk layout recovery and fine frame trajectory refinement.
The coarse stage optimizes a chunk-level Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) pose graph over adjacent overlaps and distant loop closures.
This stage establishes a globally consistent layout and eliminates accumulated scale drift.
Holding this coarse layout fixed, the fine stage optimizes a frame-level shared-camera SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) pose graph, representing each physical frame with a single camera variable to resolve cross-window pose inconsistency.
Placement priors keep that camera on the recovered layout, while within-chunk motion factors resolve conflicting predictions from overlapping windows.
We evaluate HiP3R across seven public benchmarks spanning diverse indoor and outdoor environments.
Under matched backends and windows, HiP3R improves long-horizon trajectory accuracy over loop-enabled VGGT-Long.
Controlled ablations show that bounded point sampling reduces graph construction and optimization time with little change in accuracy.
Additional evaluations show that the method also works with streaming backends such as LingBot-MAP.
We summarize our main contributions as follows: • We show that chunk-level similarity alignment alone cannot ensure cross-window camera-pose consistency, as overlapping windows may yield conflicting estimates for the same frame. • We develop a hierarchical pose graph that first recovers a globally consistent chunk layout and scale, then estimates one shared SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) camera pose for each frame. • We introduce progressive loop closure and bounded point sampling to achieve stable and scalable optimization on long sequences without retraining.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Feed-forward 3D vision models. Feed-forward 3D models have emerged as an alternative to classical Structure-from-Motion (SfM).
Pioneering architectures like DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) directly regress dense pointmaps from uncalibrated image pairs.
Recent multi-view transformers such as VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and VGGT-Omega ( Wang et al., 2026b ) extend feed-forward predictions across broader view collections.
Subsequent models explore permutation invariance ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , sparse attention ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and learned scene actions ( Wang and Agapito, 2026 ) .
These models achieve high local geometric accuracy without per-scene numerical optimization.
However, quadratic attention restricts them to short windows, so long sequences yield overlapping local reconstructions.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward 3D视觉模型. Feed-forward 3D模型已经出现,作为古典结构-off-Motion(SfM)的替代品.
如DUST3R(Wang等人,2024年)和MAST3R(Leroy等人,2024年)等先行建筑直接从未校准的图像对面递减密度点图.
近期的多景变速器如VGGT(Wang等人,2025a)和VGGT-Omega(Wang等人,2026b)将饲料向前的预测扩展到了更广泛的景色集.
后来的模型探索了常态变异(Wang等人,2025c),注意力稀少(Wang等人,2026a),以及学习的场景动作(Wang and Agapito,2026).
这些模型实现高局部几何精度,而不实现每场数值优化.
然而,四重奏的注意将其限制在短窗内,因此长序产生重叠的局部重建.

blocks.en:
Streaming and recurrent video geometry. To extend temporal context beyond static windows, another line of research develops streaming and recurrent architectures.
Early methods such as Spann3R ( Wang and Agapito, 2025 ) and CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) maintain persistent spatial memory states.
Recent methods like StreamVGGT ( Zhuo et al., 2026 ) , STream3R ( Lan et al., 2026 ) , and WinT3R ( Li et al., 2026b ) process video frames causally with temporal key-value caching.
LingBot-MAP ( Chen et al., 2026a ) structures geometric context across anchor frames, local windows, and trajectory memory.
Other approaches explore test-time training, memory compression, and feature retrieval ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) .
Causal streaming still accumulates drift on long trajectories.
As post-processing, HiP3R adds global loops and per-frame pose consistency without retraining.
blocks.zh:
流线和经常性视频几何. 为了将时间背景扩展到静态窗口之外,另一条研究线发展了流式和经常性的架构.
Spann3R(Wang and Agapito,2025年)和CUT3R(Wang等人,2025年b)等早期方法保持持续空间内存状态.
最近的方法,如StreamVGGT (Zhuo等人,2026年),STream3R(Lan等人,2026年),和WinT3R(Li等人,2026年b)通过时间键值缓存因果处理视频帧.

其他方法探讨测试时间培训、内存压缩和特征检索(Chen等人,2026年b; 张等,2026a;谢等,2026;龚等,2026;刘等,2026;邹等,2026.
导致的溪流仍然在长轨上累积漂流.
作为后处理,HiP3R增加了全局环路,每帧不进行再培训就形成一致性.

blocks.en:
Multi-window fusion and Structure-from-Motion. Scaling feed-forward predictions to extended trajectories connects to classical global Structure-from-Motion and pose graph optimization.
Chunk-based methods like VGGT-Long ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , VGGT-Align ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and VGGT-Motion ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) align adjacent chunks via pairwise Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) alignment.
A rigid Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) per chunk preserves internal cameras up to scale and cannot resolve overlapping-frame disagreements.
GlueMap ( Pan et al., 2026 ) couples feed-forward star reconstructions with global motion averaging and bundle adjustment over virtual tracks. HiP3R resolves overlapping camera predictions through a shared frame-level pose graph after chunk alignment, without optimizing 3D tracks.

VGGT-Long(Deng等人,2025年),VGGT-Align(Zhang等人,2026年b),VGGT-Motion(Xiong等人,2026年)等基于春克的方法通过对偶的Sim QQ(3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)对齐.

GlueMap(Pan等人,2026年) 配对向前进的恒星重建,全球运动平均和捆绑调整在虚拟轨道上. HiP3R在块对齐后通过共享帧级的姿势图解决了相机重叠预测,而不优化3D轨迹.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en:
Let ℐ = { I t } t = 1 T \mathcal{I}=\{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} denote an input video sequence of T T frames.
We partition ℐ \mathcal{I} into K K overlapping chunks { C k } k = 1 K \{C_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} of at most C C frames with overlap O O .
Chunk starts advance by C − O C-O frames; the final chunk may be shorter than C C .
Each chunk is processed independently by a feed-forward 3D vision model ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
For chunk C k C_{k} , the backend predicts dense pointmaps X k , i X_{k,i} , confidence maps γ k , i \gamma_{k,i} , and camera-to-chunk poses P k , i P_{k,i} .
Here i ∈ { 1 , … , | C k | } i\in\{1,\dots,|C_{k}|\} indexes local frames within the chunk.
Let g ⁡ ( k , i ) ∈ { 1 , … , T } g(k,i)\in\{1,\dots,T\} map local frame i i in chunk C k C_{k} to its global video index.
The goal is to recover a single camera trajectory ℱ = { F t ∈ SE ( 3 ) } t = 1 T \mathcal{F}=\{F_{t}\in\mathrm{SE}(3)\}_{t=1}^{T} together with consistent 3D pointmaps.
Figure 2 gives an overview.

Decoupled optimization. Directly optimizing all camera and point variables across thousands of frames is expensive.
Unconstrained bundle adjustment loses the efficiency of feed-forward models. HiP3R uses a two-level hierarchical pose graph.
Stage I solves a chunk-level Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) pose graph for a globally aligned layout (Section 3.2 ).
Stage II then optimizes a frame-level SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) pose graph with one shared camera variable per frame while holding the layout fixed (Section 3.3 ).

不受约束的捆绑调整会失去向导模型的效率. HiP3R使用双层阶梯姿势图.
第一阶段解决一个块级的Sim QQ( 3)\ mathrm{Sim}(3) 设置一个全球一致布局的图表( 第3.2节)。
然后第二阶段优化一个帧级SE(3)\mathrm{SE}(3) 以每个帧一个共享的相机变量摆出图,同时保持布局固定(第3.3节).

blocks.en:
Dense overlapping 3D points are spatially redundant, so all-pixel alignment is unnecessary.
For adjacent chunks, identical pixels in overlapping frames yield paired 3D predictions.
We estimate relative similarities with confidence-weighted iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) rather than unweighted Umeyama alignment on all dense pixels ( Deng et al., 2025 ) .
Each iteration runs a weighted Umeyama alignment ( Umeyama, 1991 ) and updates Huber weights from spatial residuals.
We bound alignment cost by limiting the number of point correspondences used in each fit.
blocks.zh:

对于相邻块,重叠帧中相同的像素产生对三维预测.

The resulting joint reconstruction connects the two visits in a common local coordinate system.
We align the predicted geometry at each endpoint to the corresponding original chunk, obtaining transformations B i B_{i} and B j B_{j} from the joint reconstruction to chunks i i and j j , respectively.

We assign each loop constraint a bounded weight w i ​ j w_{ij} based on the registration residuals at its two endpoints, reducing the influence of poorly aligned loops.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate trajectory accuracy across seven public benchmarks comprising 61 61 diverse sequences.
The benchmark spans indoor room-scale environments, including 7-Scenes ( Shotton et al., 2013 ) and Neural RGB-D ( Azinović et al., 2022 ) .
It also includes high-precision multi-scale scenes from ETH3D ( Schöps et al., 2017 ) and Tanks and Temples ( Knapitsch et al., 2017 ) .
Finally, it includes extended outdoor driving and campus traversals from Oxford Spires ( Tao et al., 2025 ) , KITTI ( Geiger et al., 2012 ) , and VBR ( Brizi et al., 2024 ) .
Dense surface geometry is evaluated on ETH3D, Neural RGB-D, and 7-Scenes, which provide dense 3D ground truth.
Appendix E details dataset compositions and sequence splits.
Baselines in Table 1 use released checkpoints and recommended window policies on identical sequences.
VGGT-Long and VGGT-Align are evaluated from public implementations, while VGGT-Motion ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) is not publicly available.

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports tracking metrics macro-averaged across the seven datasets.

blocks.en:
We compare HiP3R with two VGGT-Long ( Deng et al., 2025 ) variants, with and without loop closures.

HiP3R achieves lower ATE than both VGGT-Long variants using VGGT-Omega on all three datasets.
Loop closures reduce VGGT-Long ATE from 110.3 110.3 to 10.19 10.19 m on KITTI and from 85.50 85.50 to 41.27 41.27 m on VBR. HiP3R further reduces these errors to 9.730 9.730 and 22.44 22.44 m, nearly halving the remaining VBR error.
VGGT-Long applies loops as rigid Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) transforms to entire chunks. HiP3R instead jointly optimizes a sparse global layout graph with progressive loop scheduling.
Appendix K shows that the complete solver further improves accuracy and convergence efficiency, while Appendix F reports stage-wise runtimes.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
HiP3R turns overlapping local predictions into a globally consistent reconstruction of long video sequences through a hierarchical pose graph.
The method first recovers global layout and scale through a chunk-level Sim ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{Sim}(3) graph, then refines a shared-camera SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) graph with the chunk transforms held fixed.
This separation allows distant loop closures to correct accumulated drift while reconciling conflicting predictions of the same camera across windows.
Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks show improvements in overall trajectory accuracy and surface reconstruction with both VGGT-Omega and LingBot-MAP.
Extending this hierarchy to online updates and improving its robustness to unreliable loop closures are promising directions for future work.
blocks.zh:
HiP3R通过一个分级的姿势图,将重叠的局部预测转化为长视频序列的全球连贯重建.
该方法首先通过一个块级的Sim(3)\mathrm{Sim}(3)图恢复全局布局和尺度,然后用固定的块变换来精炼一个共享相机SE(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)图.
这种分离使得远程环闭路可以校正累积的漂移,同时调和对同一相机跨窗的相互矛盾的预测.
对室内和室外基准的评价表明,通过VGGT-Omega和LingBot-MAP,总体轨迹准确度和地面重建有所改善。
将这一等级扩展至在线更新,并将其健全性提高至不可靠的环路关闭,是未来工作的有希望的方向。

blocks.en:
The four controls in Table 5 evaluate different strategies for resolving multiple camera predictions under identical optimized coarse layouts.
Layout Only selects the first available coarse-placed pose for each frame in chunk order.
Single selects the occurrence that maximizes the minimum distance, in frames, to either boundary of its chunk.
Ties are broken by the smaller chunk index.
Both Layout Only and Single directly output the selected coarse-placed poses without frame-level optimization.
Unary computes a robust pose average over all coarse-placed occurrences of each frame using deterministic Huber IRLS, without relative-motion factors.
Motion optimizes within-chunk relative-motion factors without placement priors.
It fixes the first camera to its coarse placement and uses λ f = 1 \lambda_{f}=1 and λ p = 0 \lambda_{p}=0 .
This control allows up to 5000 5000 function evaluations with ftol = xtol = gtol = 10 − 8 \texttt{ftol}=\texttt{xtol}=\texttt{gtol}=10^{-8} .
Shared jointly optimizes placement priors and relative-motion constraints as formulated in Eq. ( 6 ), and corresponds to Full in the main benchmark.
All configurations use the same evaluation protocol, and results are macro-averaged across all seven datasets.
